headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-5, and the Cincinnati Reds shut down the Chicago Cubs 4-0. The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback against the Milwaukee Brewers, and the Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players placed on the injured list. The Atlanta Braves' Mike Yastrzemski was placed on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins' Anthony Banda was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left lat strain, while the Athletics' Nick Kurtz was placed on the 10-day injured list with a right thumb capsule sprain. The Pittsburgh Pirates' Konnor Griffin was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left ring finger sagittal back injury, and the Milwaukee Brewers' Kyle Harrison was placed on the 15-day injured list with left forearm tightness.

Several trades and roster moves have been made, including the Chicago White Sox trading LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets acquired RHP Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer 10-2 Loss to Tigers**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies fell short in a lopsided matchup against the Detroit Tigers, ultimately losing 10-2. Aaron Nola led the Phillies' pitching effort, throwing 5.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles securing the win. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Shut Down Cubs 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Hunter Greene leading the way on the mound. Greene pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Braxton Ashcraft led the Pirates' pitching effort, while William Contreras and Jake Bauers had standout performances for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, marking their latest loss. Zach Neto and Mike Trout led the Angels' offense, while Joe Ryan earned the win for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Mike Yastrzemski on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have placed left fielder Mike Yastrzemski on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a trade, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
